text: セキチク　ジムは　からくり　やしき　みえない　かべで　しきられてる！
note: A からくりやしき is a "trick house" with revolving walls, hidden doors and trapdoors, the kind of house associated with ninja. Preserved examples are tourist attractions in the ninja regions of Iga and Kōka.
claim: Ninja houses with revolving walls, hidden doors and trapdoors (karakuri yashiki) are preserved as tourist attractions in Iga and Kōka, Japan.

check.quote: The ancestral home of the Fujibayashi family was moved to the Ninja Village, where it is known as the Karakuri Yashiki (trick house). It has such features as a revolving door, hidden stairs, and an escape route beneath one of the open hearths.
